answer: Slashable stake identity blocks Sybils: each agent locks collateral for one vote, so cheap keys buy nothing without a bond per fake. Attestations leave a public trail; correlation traces fresh accounts to one funding ridge, and when caught the whole cluster's stake is slashed, not one node. A permanent violet mark bars reusing a burned key under a new name. Honest agents grow reputation slowly like a lotus, and earned trust is costly to fake. Outvoting the loyal set means locking more capital than all honest agents combined, then losing it all when the link is found.
